title: Simulation-guided Design Search Engine — Overview and definition
t: Simulation-guided Design Search Engine — Overview and definition
description: Searches design spaces with simulations in the loop and surrogate help.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Searches design spaces with simulations in the loop and surrogate help. A simulation-guided search engine explores parameterized designs using Bayesian optimization and evolutionary strategies, calling real solvers and surrogates adaptively. Real implementations include Ax/BoTorch, Optuna with CFD/FEA workers, and modeFRONTIER. It balances exploration and exploitation and stops on convergence or budget.
capabilities: Adaptive fidelity: coarse sims early, fine sims late

title: Simulation-guided Design Search Engine — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Simulation-guided Design Search Engine — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Searches design spaces with simulations in the loop and surrogate help.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Simulation-guided Design Search Engine, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Bayesian optimization with Gaussian-process surrogates). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Bayesian optimization with Gaussian-process surrogates and Multi-objective Pareto search (NSGA-II/III). Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (AI-driven design-space explorer) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
